name: OligoVigil Design System

direction.summary: A restrained scientific workbench for a NAR Database Issue submission: dense enough for database users, calm enough for trust, and explicit about evidence provenance.
principles: Evidence and search workflows are primary; imagery supports orientation only.
Use compact product UI, not marketing-page composition.
Use one 8px spacing rhythm and one restrained accent family.
Prefer tables, filters, and stable panels over decorative card walls.
Every visible number, label, and action must map to real portal data or an actual endpoint.
Search, Sources, Downloads, Benchmark, Agent Connect, API, and Cite are first-class publication-resource routes.
Sequence UI is labelled as evidence lookup only until curator-verified sequence strings enable exact alignment claims.

typography.font_family: IBM Plex Sans, Aptos, Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
typography.mono_family: IBM Plex Mono, Cascadia Code, Consolas, monospace
typography.label: 12px / 1.25 / 500
typography.caption: 12px / 1.35 / 500

components.topbar: Compact sticky product header with brand, truncated descriptor on desktop, and horizontally scrollable nav tabs on narrow screens.
components.button: Primary filled button for the main action in a local workflow; secondary links are bordered, white, and stable.
components.card: Use cards only for repeated items, metrics, or framed tools; no nested decorative cards.
components.table: Data tables are first-class surfaces with sticky headers, compact row height, and contained horizontal scroll.
components.badge: Small semantic metadata only; no decorative pill overload.
components.hero_visual: One supporting evidence/provenance image on overview; must not dominate search or status.
components.workflow_card: One-column workflow list with concise query, metadata, counts, and actions.
components.download_manifest: Grouped release file manifest with rows, bytes, SHA256, schema, license/reuse policy, and recommended use.
components.agent_access: Compact install-and-reuse surface for universal manifests, OpenAPI, llms.txt, MCP, optional skill, clients, prompts, templates, and agent guardrails.
components.source_packet: Source detail and record detail must form a provenance loop: source -> verified records -> citable record -> source packet.

anti_patterns: Large topbar that consumes mobile viewport height
Uniform card walls without task hierarchy
Multiple visible primary button blocks in one viewport
Hero imagery replacing the actual search/evidence workflow
Homepage signal-icon grids competing with search, release status, and workflow entry points
Large shadows, glass panels, gradient backgrounds, or marketing-page hero layouts

required_checks: topbar under 96px desktop and under 140px mobile/tablet
primary workflow actions visible without crowding
